_comment: The curation pool for OER-08, re-based onto the canonical nanoGPT substrate. Every architecture and run value below is replicated from environment/nanogpt_substrate.json, which is itself a byte-for-byte copy of the batch substrate record. This file names TRAIN shards only. The evaluation split is a slice of a FineWeb10B VALIDATION shard, it is held by the verifier at tests/heldout_spec.json, it is absent from this container by construction, and no slice id below resolves to it.

substrate._architecture_note: This block is the frozen architecture. It is replicated here so the pool spec and the substrate declaration cannot drift apart, and tests/runner.py refuses to run when the two disagree. The graded parameter snapshot is shape-bound to these numbers.

budget._budget_note: budget_tokens is canonical and total_tokens is the same quantity under its earlier name; environment/harness.py refuses to run when the pair disagrees. tokens_per_step is the substrate figure 524288 and is not a free axis. steps is this slot's own declaration and is provisional: it is sized to the per-attempt bound of 7.2 minutes on one H100 recorded in task.toml, and it is not an upstream record value.

corpus.name: FineWeb10B
corpus.encoding: GPT-2 BPE token ids, uint16 little-endian, 1024-byte header skipped
corpus._val_note: Named for completeness only. No validation shard is staged into this container and no slice in the pool below is drawn from one.

pool._enumeration: Slice n of a shard is the contiguous token range [n * slice_tokens, (n + 1) * slice_tokens) of that shard, counted after the 1024-byte header. Five shards at 128 slices each give 640 pool slices totalling 41943040 tokens against a 20971520 token budget.

bands.statistic_rule: For one slice, the fraction of its tokens whose GPT-2 BPE id is at or above 20000. It is computed from the shard bytes themselves and is not an authored label.
bands.assignment_rule: Sort all 640 pool slices by (rare_fraction, shard, slice-index) ascending and cut the sorted order into five contiguous groups of 128. Group k is band-k. The rule is total, deterministic and recomputed identically by environment/harness.py and by tests/runner.py, so no band membership is transcribed into this file.
bands._why_bands: FineWeb10B is one web corpus, so a source label such as curated or technical would be authored provenance rather than a property of the bytes. A band is a measured property of the tokens it holds, so allocating across bands is a curation decision about the corpus rather than a decision about a label this bundle invented.

dev_probe._probe_note: An agent-visible probe drawn from a TRAIN shard that carries no pool slice, so it is disjoint from everything a plan can feed and is not the graded split. It is a different, much smaller sample than the verifier's held-out validation slice and it is one sample rather than two folds, so it cannot show you a fold artifact.

filter._filter_note: What the pool publisher declares it filtered. tests/runner.py records the declared filter against the filter that actually held and never silently repairs the pool it is grading.
